newsitem.title: USA: MUNICIPAL BOND SALES TOTAL $213 MLN FOR THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: MUNICIPAL BOND SALES TOTAL $213 MLN FOR THURSDAY.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday, August 14 were expected to total $213 million in 18 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings totalled $105 million in seven sales, with a $35 million Jefferson Parish, La., offering through John Nuveen & Co., Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 11 sales totaling $108 million were scheduled. A $36 million Worcester, Mass., offering at 1100 EDT was the largest.
An additional five sales totaling $193 million were on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Thursday depending on market conditions.
